title: 第一章 飞机坠落
content_zh:
波音777的舷窗外，积雨云像被打翻的墨汁，在天幕上晕开厚重的灰黑。陈默握着操纵杆的手微微用力，指节泛白——雷达屏幕上的红色预警像跳动的火焰，预示着一场罕见的强气流正在逼近。

    “各位乘客，我们即将穿越一片不稳定气流，请您系好安全带，洗手间将暂停使用。”空乘的声音透过广播传来，带着职业性的平稳，却掩不住尾音的紧绷。

    陈默侧头看了眼副驾老李，对方额角渗着汗：“默哥，风速已经到70节了，这势头不对劲。”

    “保持高度，稳住油门。”陈默的声音比平时沉了半度，目光死死锁着仪表盘。他飞了十二年，从支线客机到洲际宽体机，见过晴空湍流，遇过雷暴云团，却从没见过这样诡异的云层——像一个巨大的漩涡，在万米高空缓缓转动，边缘泛着诡异的紫蓝色。

    机身突然剧烈颠簸，客舱里传来惊叫声。陈默猛地拉升操纵杆，飞机像被一只无形的手狠狠攥住，瞬间失重的眩晕感压得人喘不过气。窗外的云层旋转得越来越快，紫蓝色的光晕变成狰狞的蛇，顺着舷窗缝隙往里钻。

    “是龙卷风！”老李失声喊道，手指颤抖地指向雷达，屏幕上的红色漩涡已经吞噬了整个航线，“我们被卷进去了！”

    陈默的瞳孔骤然收缩。他试图调整航向，可飞机像狂风中的落叶，完全失去控制。客舱里的氧气面罩自动脱落，哭喊声、尖叫声混着金属扭曲的刺耳声响，在密闭空间里炸开。他最后看到的，是副驾老李惊恐的脸，和窗外那个仿佛要吞噬一切的、旋转的黑暗深渊。

    失重感达到顶点时，陈默失去了意识。

content_en:
Outside the window of the Boeing 777, cumulonimbus clouds were like spilled ink, spreading thick gray and black on the sky. Chen Mo's hand holding the joystick was slightly firm, and his knuckles turned white - the red warning on the radar screen was like a dancing flame, indicating that a rare strong airflow was approaching.

    "Dear passengers, we are about to pass through an unstable airflow. Please fasten your seat belts. The restroom will be temporarily suspended." The flight attendant's voice came through the broadcast, with a professional calmness, but it could not hide the tightness of the ending.

    Chen Mo turned his head and glanced at the co-pilot, Lao Li, who was sweating on his forehead: "Brother Mo, the wind speed has reached 70 knots. This momentum is not right."

    "Keep the altitude and hold the throttle steady." Chen Mo's voice was half a degree darker than usual, and his eyes were fixed on the dashboard. He has been flying for twelve years, from regional airliners to intercontinental wide-body aircraft. He has seen clear sky turbulence and encountered thunderstorm clouds, but he has never seen such strange clouds - like a huge vortex, slowly rotating at an altitude of 10,000 meters, with a strange purple-blue color at the edge.

    The fuselage suddenly jolted violently, and screams came from the cabin. Chen Mo suddenly pulled up the control stick, and the plane seemed to be tightly grasped by an invisible hand. The dizzy feeling of weightlessness was so overwhelming that it made people breathless. The clouds outside the window rotated faster and faster, and the purple-blue halo turned into a ferocious snake, burrowing through the gap in the porthole.

    "It's a tornado!" Lao Li shouted, pointing at the radar with trembling fingers. The red vortex on the screen had swallowed up the entire route, "We are involved!"

    Chen Mo's pupils suddenly shrank. He tried to adjust its course, but the plane was like falling leaves in the strong wind and completely out of control. The oxygen mask in the cabin automatically fell off, and cries and screams mixed with the harsh sound of twisted metal exploded in the confined space. The last thing he saw was the terrified face of the co-pilot, Lao Li, and the swirling dark abyss outside the window that seemed to swallow everything.

    When the feeling of weightlessness reached its peak, Chen Mo lost consciousness.
